# Bitdepth

> Bitdepth moves routine AI jobs (status checks, monitoring, tagging, summaries) from frontier models to cheaper open models that pass the same job, and re-tests them weekly. A free savings report is at https://bitdepth.dev/#report. Underneath are independent nightly grades for AI inference endpoints. Every endpoint serving the same open-weight model is probed each night with the same prompt set, scored against a published reference, and shown beside its price.

Contact: hello@bitdepth.dev

## Pages

- [Home](https://bitdepth.dev/): cut your AI bill, keep the quality. Bitdepth tests repeat AI jobs on cheaper models and shows which can switch. Nov 13, 2026 test: $258.53 a month on a frontier model, $11.04 after.
- [Sample report](https://bitdepth.dev/sample-report): what a savings report contains, job by job.
- [Leaderboard](https://bitdepth.dev/leaderboard): every endpoint for each model, ranked by quality-adjusted price.
- [About](https://bitdepth.dev/about): what Bitdepth does in plain words, how a request reaches a provider, why it is called Bitdepth, a glossary and common questions.
- [Method](https://bitdepth.dev/method): the unit, the nightly procedure, the reference rule, the noise floor, rubric v0 and the publication policy.
- [Market](https://bitdepth.dev/market): reserving inference capacity at a fixed price with the grade checked nightly.
